name: Temptation Sailing
summary: Wild dolphin swim and watch tours, sunset and day cruises, and private charters on Temptation, a 58ft sailing catamaran based at the Marina Pier in Glenelg. Dolphin tours are hosted by marine biologists, and swimmers hold a line or lie on a net at the bow while the dolphins come to the boat. The season runs from September to April.
standouts: Advanced Eco Certified through Ecotourism Australia since 2015
First vessel in South Australia given a dolphin swim licence; dolphin swims from Glenelg since January 2002
Wild Dolphin Tours hosted by marine biologists

contact.address: Marina Pier, Holdfast Shores Marina, Glenelg SA 5045

trips.title: Wild Dolphin Tour
trips.summary: A morning tour on Temptation to swim with or watch wild Indo-Pacific bottlenose and short-beaked common dolphins off Glenelg, hosted by marine biologists. Swimmers either lie on a net between the bows or hold mermaid lines off the back of the boat, and the crew rotates people between the two. Non-swimmers watch from the 360 degree front deck on the same boat.
highlights: Swim or watch options on the same boat
Front Swim net between the bows and Back Swim lines off the stern
Hosted by marine biologists
Full-length 5mm wetsuit and all swim gear provided
trips.season: September to April (operating season; no cruises May to August)
trips.departsFrom: Marina Pier, Glenelg (bottom of the stairs/ramp in front of the Oyster Bar)

prices.label: Cruise photos and GoPro footage (Google Drive link)

includes: Full-length 5mm wetsuit, which also acts as a flotation device
Crew briefing (about 15 minutes) and snorkel demonstration
bring: Snacks and bottled water or juice for the kids (bar is closed on this tour, no BYO alcohol)
Warm jacket or jumper
Optional: your own full-length wetsuit, booties, mask and snorkel (fins not required)
Optional: your own GoPro or camera
trips.requirements: Swim: minimum age 9; under 18s need a parent or guardian on board; must be able to hold the flotation line while towed slowly and climb the ladder at the back of the boat; people with a pacemaker can only do the Front Swim. Watch: all ages. Not wheelchair accessible.
trips.checkNotes: Prices from the Pricing List page; the tour page shows none. Duration from the FAQ ('approximately 4 hours', back in the Marina between 11:30am and midday); start time not stated. Up to 24 swimmers and 26 watchers. The FAQ carries an algal bloom notice saying the Wild Dolphin Swim may not operate this season, with a full refund if tours are cancelled; check current status before publishing. The site claims it has never had a day without seeing dolphins; not repeated here.

trips.title: Kauwi Cultural Cruise
trips.summary: A cruise down Adelaide's southern coast run with Southern Cultural Immersion, guided by a First Nations guide and a marine biologist. Guests hear Dreaming stories of Kaurna Yerta and learn about the coast's ocean life and landscapes. It runs on Mondays in season and can also be booked privately for work or school groups.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Temptation can be hired for birthdays, work functions, weddings, ashes scatterings and other events, for up to 50 guests. Charters run 1.5 to 3 hours, any day between 12 noon and 11:00pm, with your own music. There is no food on board, so groups bring their own or use a caterer, and drinks come from the licensed bar.

offers.text: No Dolphin Policy: if no dolphins are seen from above the water, come back free within one year
offers.conditions: Not transferable to friends or family. Interstate or overseas visitors who cannot return within the year get a half refund. Swimmers who did not see dolphins underwater can have the swim to watch price difference refunded or come back within one year. Refunds for direct bookings only.

checkNotes: All public prices come from the Pricing List page; tour pages show none. Departure times are only stated for the Afternoon Tea Cruise (12:30pm); other times are in the Rezdy calendar, which was not opened. FAQ algal bloom notice: the Wild Dolphin Swim may be affected this season, so confirm it is running before publishing. Tour pages link a 'Wellness At Sea' tour, but /wellness-at-sea/ shows only the homepage content, so it was not captured. Gift vouchers are sold through the Rezdy gift card catalog (temptationsailing.rezdy.com/catalog/171689/gift-cards). Phone shown on site as 0412 811 838. The site uses several absolute claims (carbon neutral as a percentage, a dolphin sighting guarantee); these were kept out of copy.
